name: 20% Damage Absorption Scroll
description:
Taken damage is decreased by 20% for 30 minutes.

**How To Use**
Will be in use once right clicked.

**Restriction**
Cannot be used with another item or skill that has a similar effect.

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
